name: zanker-design-system-discovery
description: Extract and prioritize real project tokens, components and visual conventions.

workflow.instruction: Read project.manifest.json and key CSS or theme files.
Create a semantic map of typography, color roles, spacing, radius, shadow and motion.
Locate canonical components and note where consuming screens might regress.
Describe discrepancies as proposals; do not overwrite global tokens during analysis.

acceptance: Design system precedes generic Zanker defaults
fallback: Use a provisional token map clearly labeled as inferred.
